title: Dissolve Ember plates through light and bake the next plate early
acceptance: R1 over 60 s: centre brightness never falls below 60% of its 1 s running median for more than one frame.
R5 at plate rotation: no task over 100 ms at 390x844 @3 with 4x CPU throttle after the first 2 s.

evidence.note: Package A2; requirements R1 and R5.

summary: R1 holds: each plate is born over the one before and the screen never dissolves through the dark ground. The seam no longer freezes (the bake restarted on every sync and was then finished in one call). R5's 100 ms bar is still missed: frames take ~95-111 ms throughout the reading at 390x844 @3 with 4x CPU throttle, on production too.
